analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1.00) vs SMA5 ($1.01)/SMA20 ($1.04)/SMA50 ($1.08) — below short/mid-term trends, weakening long-term trend
· Below SMA100 ($1.17)/SMA200 ($1.29) — indicating strong bearish long-term trend
· 52-week position (0.6%) + current price near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.2→35.6) + attempting to exit oversold, preparing to enter neutral zone
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0051→-0.0038) + improving, diagnosed as bearish convergence
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $1.04) + band width at 11.16% indicating contraction
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.58) + confirmed support based on Pivot S1 ($0.96)
· Swing resistance ($1.13) + short-term rebound expected on breaking Bollinger upper band ($1.10)
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + confirmed recovery signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.63x) + indicating low confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + wait-and-see condition based on $1.00 support confirmation and breaking $1.10 resistance
